issues.issue: Every 'Operating expenses' line in Schedules 1-4 (e.g. Miscellaneous 476,136; Road 245,197; Inheritance 283,097) is mapped to professional/contract services. The line is a broad object group, not specifically contracted services; 'not itemized' or a review note may be more accurate.

Schedule 4 prints the line as 'State', but Exhibit D (p4) and Schedule 5 (p15) count it as Charges for services, and receipts[] records it there. The categories are inconsistent across the report's own statements.

The top-level receipts split out motor vehicle taxes 156,593 (Exhibit B), but the General Fund detail line keeps all 440,864 as state aid with a review note. Defensible because the schedule prints only a broad group, but the two levels categorize the same money differently.
